conversation.user_request: Modify escalation logic to send emails repeatedly at specified delay while monitor remains down instead of only once

logic_change.before: escalationsSent tracked indices as a boolean array - each escalation sent only once
logic_change.after: escalationsSent stores last minute each escalation was sent - allows repeat sends at each configured interval

implementation: Changed escalationsSent to store elapsed minutes instead of boolean flags
Check if already sent this minute: skip if escalationsSent[i] === elapsedMinutes
Check if enough time for repeat: skip if elapsedMinutes - lastSentMinute < escalation.delay
Send escalation and update escalationsSent[i] = elapsedMinutes before persisting

Monitor: escalations: Array of { delay (number), type (string), contacts (string[]) }
firstDownAt: Date (tracks when monitor first went down)
escalationsSent: Array of numbers (tracks last minute each escalation was sent)

backend_flow: 1. Monitor check fails, statusService sets firstDownAt = new Date()
3. If monitor.status === 'down', escalation logic evaluates all configured escalations
4. For each escalation with delay <= elapsedMinutes and lastSentMinute < elapsedMinutes - delay, send emails
5. Store lastSentMinute in escalationsSent[i] to prevent duplicate sends in same minute
6. On monitor recovery (status = 'up'), clear firstDownAt and reset escalationsSent
frontend_ui: Users can add multiple escalation tiers with delay (minutes) and email addresses
Each escalation row has remove button
Escalations automatically submitted with monitor form data
email_sending: Uses existing EmailProvider and EmailService infrastructure
Reuses notificationMessageBuilder for consistent message formatting
Escalation emails sent using same nodemailer transport as regular notifications
Errors logged but don't interrupt monitor check flow
recurring_behavior: Escalations repeat at configured intervals while monitor remains down
If escalation delay is 30 minutes, email resends every 30 minutes during downtime
Once monitor recovers, escalation tracking resets for next incident

verification_points: Monitor goes down -> firstDownAt set in database
30-minute escalation delay -> initial escalation email sent at ~30 minute mark (plus/minus check interval)
Monitor still down at 60 minutes -> escalation email sent again
Monitor still down at 90 minutes -> escalation email sent again
Monitor recovers -> escalationsSent reset, ready for next incident
Server logs show escalation processing, skips, and sends
